title: LR-FHSS gateway dual-mode RX absent; spec references nonexistent bead project-LICHEN-zd2d.2 (spec 02 3.7)
description: Req R-02-039: Gateway MUST implement dual-mode RX (standard LoRa + LR-FHSS on same frequency). NOT-IMPLEMENTED: zero fhss hits in lichen/subsys, lichen/drivers, rust/lichen-hal, rust/lichen-embassy; DR8-DR11 and OCW 137/336 kHz constants exist only in python/src/lichen/link/lr_fhss.py:15 docstring; the collision/airtime model lives in external package lora_medium. Capability-advertisement layer is implemented+tested in Python only (lr_fhss.py:27-28 vs lr_fhss_capability.json; flags absent in Rust/C — divergence rows R-02-036/037/040/041). spec/02-physical-link.md:179 defers the driver to child issue project-LICHEN-zd2d.2 which does NOT exist in bd — this bead replaces that pointer. test/vectors/lr_fhss.json (airtime/sensitivity/fragment-collision) has no implementation consumer. Suggested placement: SX1262 LR-FHSS driver behind lichen/drivers + lichen-embassy; dual-mode gateway RX; port DIO/Announce flag layer to Rust/C.
